opening.argument: The speaker reports losing money in BitConnect and tells viewers not to sign up. He describes the loss as his own experience, then calls BitConnect a scam and urges people to stay away. His account of how the platform promised daily percentages and repayment after 120 days explains what he says went wrong; it is not an invitation to invest or a promise that viewers will earn returns. The description requests Bitcoin donations, but it makes no deceptive benefit claim and does not tie a donation to any investment outcome. Taken together, the personal account and direct warning are criticism of an alleged scam, not promotion of it.
